name: Tower Defense

angles.text: As a warrior, you know a hold against superior numbers tests stamina as much as skill. Discipline on the frontline can keep the defense from collapsing.

faq.answer: Tower Defense is a desperate defense against overwhelming numbers. The line still holds, but exhaustion threatens to break it unless the stalemate ends.
The attackers outnumber the defenders and press hard enough to wear down the garrison. The cult is attacking the pylon watchtower outside town.
The defenders are tiring from prolonged combat under relentless assault. Without relief, the garrison risks losing ground unless the stalemate breaks soon.
faq.q: What is the current status of the defenders?

aliases: what happens after holding them off
faq.answer: Holding off the assault buys only a little time. Fatigue will wear down the defenders unless they find a way to break the deadlock.
faq.q: Does holding the line resolve the battle?

faq.answer: The defense takes place at a fortified outpost under siege. Constant pressure from numerous attackers has stretched the defenders thin.
faq.q: Where does this defense take place?

aliases: what needs to be done next
faq.answer: The defenders need a swift plan to break the siege before their exhausted frontline gives way.
faq.q: What is needed to turn the tide?

sections.body: The garrison holds back the first assault at a fortified position. Yet the attackers outnumber them and keep pressing forward. The surviving fighters are growing tired, and the line between survival and defeat grows thin.
sections.title: A Beleaguered Defense

sections.body: The garrison keeps its perimeter, but time favors the attackers. Prolonged skirmishes against superior numbers drain the defenders’ strength. They need a decisive move to break the stalemate before their lines buckle.
sections.title: The Threat of Attrition

summary: At the fortified position, Tower Defense holds against overwhelming numbers. The defenders have kept the line for now, but exhaustion threatens to break it.
